name: Gene Expression Matrix
description: Standard tabular gene expression matrix where each row represents a gene/feature and each column a sample. This format is widely used in RNA-seq and microarray analyses to represent normalized or raw counts for statistical comparison between conditions.

name: Differential Expression Results
description: Tabular results from differential expression analysis (e.g., DESeq2, edgeR, limma) summarizing effect sizes and significance metrics per gene. Useful for downstream pathway analysis or ranking features by expression change.f
